summary.text: In Jamuraa, Kaervek's armies cripple Ufunguo, a magical trap destroys Tefemburu and Kaervek's armies, and Kaervek sails to Teferi's Isle, where Teferi destroys his armada and Jolrael turns on him.
Meanwhile, on Jund, Nicol Bolas lures Rakka Mar with the promise of more magical power, and she betrays the Jundian hunters to bring Sarkhan Vol to Bolas until Ajani kills her.
